summary: Tipperary-born railroad brakeman of Wilkes-Barre; brother of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan.
bio: John Heffernan was baptized on 29 August 1852 in County Tipperary, Ireland, a brother of Andrew H. Heffernan, John's 3rd-great-grandfather. He came to America with the family in about 1864 to 1866; the 1900 census gives 1866 as the year of his arrival, and his obituary described him as 'for the past forty years a resident of this valley'. He worked as a brakeman on the DL&W railroad and died at Wilkes-Barre, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, on 16 November 1904.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (citing Wilkes-Barre Times 17 Nov 1904)
